ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bajaj Finserv Limited has approved the issuance of 1,511,358 new equity shares, valued at approximately Rs. 196.08 crore at their respective grant prices, to the Bajaj Finserv ESOP Trust to fulfill existing employee stock option obligations. This primary issuance will result in a minor dilution for existing shareholders, but represents a standard operational action for employee incentivization with no apparent red flags.
